--**-- FUNCTIONS --**--
function c_RandomChoice (list)
    return list[Random(1, #list)]
end
function c_RandomChoiceReturnIndex (list)
    c_random_in_table = Random(1, #list)
    return {list[c_random_in_table], c_random_in_table}
end
function c_checkClosestInArray(c_Array, c_Distance, c_TimeUntilLoop)
    c_CheckArray = c_Array[1]
    c_CheckArraySem = false
    c_CheckArrayDist = GetDistFromMC(c_CheckArray)
    c_TimeUntilLoop = c_TimeUntilLoop or 100
    for c_CheckClosest_i = 1, #c_Array do
        c_curr_dist = GetDistFromMC(c_Array[c_CheckClosest_i])
        if c_curr_dist < c_Distance then
            if c_curr_dist < c_CheckArrayDist then
                c_CheckArray = c_Array[c_CheckClosest_i]
                c_CheckArrayDist = GetDistFromMC(c_CheckArray)
                c_CheckArraySem = true
            end
        end
    end
    Wait(c_TimeUntilLoop)
    if not c_CheckArraySem then
        return nil
    else
        return c_CheckArray
    end
end

function c_KillActorOnInit(c_ActorID)
    if c_ActorID ~= nil then
        KillActor(c_ActorID)
        print'-----------------------'
        print(c_ActorID, "actor is killed")
        print'-----------------------'
    else return nil
    end
end

--
----returns the distance from the waypoint 
function fz_getDistanceG (vz_waypoint)
    dist = GetDistFromMC_Z(vz_waypoint)
    if dist < 0 then
        vz_ip = GetDistFromMC(vz_waypoint)
        return fz_sqrt(vz_ip*vz_ip - dist*dist)
    else
        return dist
    end
end

function fz_RandomChoices (az_list, vz_number)
    vz_number = vz_number or 1
    az_temp_RandomChoiceM_list = {}
    az_temp_RandomChoiceM_list_delete = az_list
    for z_i=1, vz_number do
        vz_random_in_table = Random(1, #az_temp_RandomChoiceM_list_delete)
        fz_insert(az_temp_RandomChoiceM_list, az_temp_RandomChoiceM_list_delete[vz_random_in_table])
        fz_remove(az_temp_RandomChoiceM_list_delete, vz_random_in_table)
    end

---checks the array for the closest waypoint to the MC and returns it. If None returns nil
function fz_checkClosestInArrayM (az_array, vz_distance, vz_time_until_next_loop)

    vz_check = az_array[1]
    vz_dist = fz_getDistanceG(vz_check)
    bz_check = false
    vz_time_until_next_loop = vz_time_until_next_loop or 0
    for z_i=1, #az_array do
        vz_getDistanceG = fz_getDistanceG(az_array[z_i])
        if vz_getDistanceG < vz_distance and vz_getDistanceG <= vz_dist then
                bz_check = true
                vz_check = az_array[z_i]
                vz_dist = vz_getDistanceG
        end
    end
    --Wait(vz_time_until_next_loop)
    if not bz_check then
        return nil
    else
        return vz_check
    end
end

    bz_check = false
    for z_i=1, #az_array do
        vz_distance_check = GetGroundDistBetweenObjects(0, az_array[z_i])
        if vz_distanceMin <= vz_distance_check and vz_distance_check <= vz_distanceMax 
        and IsCameraFacing(az_array[z_i]) then
            bz_check = true
            return az_array[z_i]
        else
            bz_check = false
        end
    end
    if not bz_check then
        return nil
    end
end

    bz_check = false
    vz_time_until_next_loop = vz_time_until_next_loop or 0
    for z_i=1, #az_array do

        if vz_getDistanceG < vz_distance and vz_getDistanceG >= vz_dist then
            bz_check = true
            vz_dist = vz_getDistanceG
            vz_check = az_array[z_i]
        end
    end
    if not bz_check then
        return nil
    else
        return vz_check
    end

function r_RandomChoice (list)

    random_in_table = Random(1, #list)

end
function r_find_array_key(array,value)
    for k,v in pairs(array) do
        if v == value then
            return k
        end
    end
    return nil
end
function r_copy_array(array) 
    local r_temp_array = {}
    for k,v in pairs(array) do
        r_temp_array[k] = v;
    end
    return r_temp_array;
end
function r_check_arrays_identical(array1, array2)
    for k,v in pairs(array1) do
        if (array2[k] == nil or array2[k] ~= v) then
            return false
        end
    end
    return true
end

function r_filter(array,func)
    for k,v in pairs(array) do
        if not func(v) then
            array[k] = nil
        end
    end
end

function r_map(array, func)
    for k,v in pairs(array) do
        func(v)
    end
end

function r_check(array,func)
    local r_passed = true
    for k,v in pairs(array) do
        if func(v) == false then
            r_passed = false
            break
        end
    end    
    return r_passed
end

function r_persistent_map(array, func)
    local r_temp_array = {}
    for k,v in pairs(array) do
        r_temp_array[k] = func(v)
    end
    return r_temp_array
end

function r_reduce(array, func)
    r_temp_array = {}
    for k,v in pairs(array) do
        if(func(v)) then
            temp_array[k] = v
        end
    end
    return r_temp_array
end

function r_max(array,func) 
    local r_max = nil
    local r_retval = nil
    for k,v in pairs(array) do
        if(not r_max or func(v) > r_max) then
            r_retval = v
            r_max = func(v)
        end
    end
    return r_retval
end

function r_min(array,func) 
    local r_max = nil
    local r_retval = nil
    for k,v in pairs(array) do
        if(not r_max or func(v) < r_max) then
            r_retval = v
            r_max = func(v)
        end
    end
    return r_retval
end

function r_shuffle_array(array,steps)
    local _steps = steps
    if not _steps then
        _steps = #array
    end
    for i=1,_steps do
        local r_array_pos = Random(1,#array)
        local r_array_pos_val = array[r_array_pos]
        table.remove(array,r_array_pos)
        table.insert(array,1,r_array_pos_val)
    end
end

function Obj600076_Always(...)
if r_check(r_bad_guys,IsDead) and #r_support_guys == 0 then
    if r_pressure_current_park_police_development == 0 then
        r_pressure_current_park_police_development = 1
        NPCGoToWaypointWithNavmesh(600071, 600845)
        NPCGoToWaypointWithNavmesh(600073, 600846)
        
        ActorSetState(600071,"Ranged_Run")
        ActorSetState(600073,"Ranged_Run")
        
        Wait(5000)
        
        local r_pressure_temp_en1 = SpawnObject("Ranged_Enemy_Test", 600059)
        local r_pressure_temp_en2 = SpawnObject("Ranged_Enemy_Test", 600062)
        local r_pressure_temp_en3 = SpawnObject("Ranged_Enemy_Test", 600065)
        r_bad_guys = {r_pressure_temp_en1,r_pressure_temp_en2,r_pressure_temp_en3}
    elseif r_pressure_current_park_police_development == 1 then
        local r_pressure_change_officer_objective = 600699
        local r_pressure_init_snipers_situation = 600716
        ActorSetState(600071,"Low_Cover_Idle")
        ActorSetState(600073,"Low_Cover_Idle")
        Enable(r_pressure_init_snipers_situation)
        Disable(r_pressure_change_officer_objective)
        Disable()
        Wait(1)
        Wait(1)
        SaveGame(600834)
    end
else

    local function r_filter_not_dead(id)
        return not IsDead(id)
    end
    
    local r_temp_bad = r_copy_array(r_bad_guys)
    
    r_map(r_bad_guys,ObjectiveRemove)
    r_map(r_support_guys,ObjectiveRemove)
    r_filter(r_bad_guys,r_filter_not_dead)
    r_filter(r_support_guys,r_filter_not_dead)

    local r_wait_factor = 1.5
    local r_park_policemen = {600071,600073}
    local attacker = r_RandomChoice(r_park_policemen)
    local target = r_RandomChoice(r_bad_guys)
    local r_closest_en = r_min(r_bad_guys,GetDistFromMC)
    if GetDistFromMC(r_closest_en) < 6 then
        NPCAttackTarget(r_closest_en,0)
    end
    if(r_last_wait_value ~=nil and GetTime() - r_last_wait_value > r_wait_factor) then
        r_last_wait_value = GetTime()
        if ActorGetState(attacker) == "Low_Cover_Idle" or ActorGetState(attacker) == "Ranged_Idle"  and target ~= nil then
            ActorLookTo(attacker,target,500,180,0,0)
            ActorSetState(attacker, "Low_Cover_Idle_To_Shoot")
        elseif ActorGetState(attacker) == "Low_Cover_Shoot_Loop" then
            ActorSetState(attacker,"Low_Cover_Shoot_To_Cover")
        end
        print(attacker,"attacking",target, ActorGetState(attacker))
    end    
    if not r_closest_en then
        r_closest_en = r_min(r_support_guys,GetDistFromMC)
    end
    if r_closest_en then
        ObjectiveAdd(r_closest_en,'kill')
    end
end
end
